title: Reusable visual review to bounded improvement plan
problem: Screenshot-led corrections are currently authored as one-off Blender patches. The product needs a reusable visual interpretation layer that can bind pixel evidence to scene entities and compile model observations into deterministic, auditable, authority-limited improvement plans.

architecture.modelRole: Produce a strict VisualAssessment from a VisualReviewPacket; it may diagnose and recommend semantic treatments but may not emit or execute Python, shell commands, arbitrary paths, Blender operators or raw scene mutations.
architecture.deterministicRole: Validate every identity and reference, reject unsupported authority, prioritize issues, map semantic treatments through a frozen allowlist and emit a canonical VisualImprovementPlan with a self hash.
architecture.executorRole: A later separately tested adapter may translate approved plan operations into typed SceneSpec or BuildPlan changes. PC4-VU1 performs zero scene mutation.
architecture.learningRole: Accepted and rejected VisualAssessment fixtures are versioned teaching examples. Future model revisions are evaluated against the same contract and holdouts rather than receiving project-specific scripts.

acceptance.schemaStrictness: All three document schemas reject unknown properties and non-finite or out-of-range numeric values.
acceptance.identityBinding: Every frame URI and SHA-256 is verified; every assessment frame, shot and entity reference must exist in the packet.
acceptance.evidenceBinding: Every actionable issue binds at least one exact frame and normalized image region; no whole-project assertion is accepted without visible evidence.
acceptance.authorityBoundary: No document field can carry source code, shell commands, Blender operators, network requests or arbitrary filesystem paths. Output operations are selected only from the frozen semantic treatment catalog.
acceptance.determinism: Two independent compilations of the same canonical packet and assessment produce canonical-exact plan bytes and the same planHash.
acceptance.priorityPolicy: Blocking composition issues precede modeling, animation and polish; confidence below 0.65 is routed to NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE and emits no mutation operation.
acceptance.strengthPreservation: The plan explicitly preserves accepted lighting and camera-language strengths while allowing shot-specific reframing.
acceptance.fixtureOutcome: The PC.4 attempt-03 fixture compiles to a plan that clears the named foreground occluders, replaces primitive joint readings, adds head/face structure, reframes the medium and close views and protects lighting/camera strengths.

stopRules: Stop before plan emission if a referenced frame hash, shot, entity, category or treatment is unknown.
Stop before plan emission if assessment data attempts to carry executable or free-form mutation authority.
Retain a failing evidence root; never weaken a schema or threshold to convert failure into pass.
Do not translate the plan into Blender changes until the visual understanding compiler and independent negatives pass.
nonClaims: PC4-VU1 does not prove that a vision model is always aesthetically correct.
PC4-VU1 does not mutate a .blend file or prove the later executor.
The first labeled fixture is a teaching seed, not a statistically representative dataset.
Human taste and final editorial approval remain explicit product inputs.
